subject.title: feat(webui): reintroduce opt-in AI purpose titles for tool calls

question: After the concrete state and auth-routing defects are repaired, should OpenClaw permanently support model-generated tool-call titles as a default-off core Control UI feature?
rationale: Correctness fixes cannot determine whether the new config, operator-write RPC, provider egress, token spend, generated client contract, and SQLite cache belong in core after the deterministic title path was intentionally restored.

options.title: Accept the opt-in feature
options.body: Keep deterministic default-off behavior and land only after repair, clean rebase, real proof, and explicit upgrade and routing review.

options.title: Keep deterministic core
options.body: Close this PR and the linked feature issue, retaining semantic model-free tool rows as the only core behavior.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Pause for a solution that avoids some combination of the new gateway method, configuration surface, provider call, or persistent cache.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in feature
recommendation.body: Keep deterministic default-off behavior and land only after repair, clean rebase, real proof, and explicit upgrade and routing review.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced both the original title feature and its deterministic removal and is the strongest available history owner for the product tradeoff.
